feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 9:49pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 9:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Outbreaks of rain will continue persistent and heavy at times overnight, light easterly winds backing northerly by the end of the night and with minimum temperature around 9°C.

Outbreaks of rain will continue through the morning tomorrow, before clearing through the afternoon, but remaining fairly cloudy. Temperatures up to 15°C, in a light to moderate northeast wind.


##Outlook##

A cloudy start to Bank Holiday Monday, but dry with sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate northerly winds with a top temperature up to 14°C.


##Sunrise##

5:38am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

8:53pm Tomorrow
